entries.description: Authored ai-assignment.md via route(analysis, hint=55) -> gemini-pro
Routed analysis (complexity 65) -> gemini-pro; wrote retrospective

Read accessexportertemp1-import artifacts directly: import-plan.md, change-log.md, ai-assignment.md (all 6 sessions), session-reviews/session-001..006.md, issue-logs/session-001.json + session-006.json, next-session-recommendation.md, plus project-guidance.md + lessons-learned.md.

Read VBA-Parser-Migration-Harvester-Plan.md (893 lines) end-to-end with retrospective lens: noted Phase 1 + Phase 3 as synthesis-heavy splits, 12 module-level test fixtures vs plan's 10-20 database-level fixtures gap, ~32-session breakdown in Appendix E.

Drafted finding table with 18 candidate findings spanning calibration deviations, verifier-finding patterns, lessons-learned promotions, and structural artifacts of the harvester-import set; embedded into the routed synthesis prompt.

Wrote docs/session-sets/vba-parser-session-set-generator/harvester-import-retrospective.md (final 20-row finding table + cross-cutting themes + adopt-now action map) directly from the routed synthesis output.
End-of-session cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4 (round 1).
Round-2 cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4 (after fixing 5 Major findings).
Round-3 (final) cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4.
Routed analysis recommending orchestrator for Session 2 (target: see next-session-recommendation.md).
Read harvester-import-retrospective.md; extracted 3 Session 2 adopt-now rows (#1, #2, #3).
Read docs/VBA-Parser-Migration-Harvester-Plan.md (893 lines, 9 phases) end-to-end.

Read docs/test-cases/README.md (270 lines, 12-case enumeration with per-case coverage description); did not re-read each .bas/.cls/.sql/.txt source since README enumerates each case's coverage exhaustively.

Built test-case coverage table mapping plan phases to fixtures; identified one gap (Phase 4 metadata extraction needs DB-level .accdb fixtures, deferred to that child via test-builder/) and 6 README-noted not-covered patterns (linked tables, passthrough, transactions, query-of-queries, unbound forms, addins) which are noise here -- they belong to integration-test child set.

Decomposition synthesis handled in-conversation rather than via route(planning) -- per project-guidance.md Convention 'When the orchestrator's model matches the routing target...' since Opus orchestrator + planning pins to Opus. Logged here as a non-routed reasoning step.

Wrote docs/session-sets/vba-parser-session-set-generator/session-set-tree.md: 17 child session sets, 65-82 total sessions, DAG with parallelizable branches at #1||#2 and #14||#15, critical path 14 children. Applied retrospective adopt-now rows #1 (≤2 synthesis per child), #2 (tree as canonical source), #3 (enumerated values throughout).
End-of-session cross-provider verification round 1 via gpt-5-4.
Round-2 cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4 after fixing 3 Major + 2 Medium round-1 findings.
Round-3 (final) cross-provider verification via gpt-5-4.
